missing_records.reason: Concealment of missing-record URLs is not required. These are stored administrator-authored values, and agents cannot mutate site settings while any content rule is active, so this interface does not allow agents to submit arbitrary URL candidates as an existence probe. A missing record has no governed content. This oracle leaves preservation versus redaction of missing URLs unspecified; any future agent-writable URL/read surface needs its own existence-oracle review.
